package validators

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	answeruc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
)

type OrchestratorClient struct {
	baseURL       string
	internalToken string
	client        *http.Client
}

const maxValidationOrchestratorResponseBytes int64 = 4 << 20

func NewOrchestratorClient(baseURL, internalToken string) *OrchestratorClient {
	baseURL = strings.TrimRight(strings.TrimSpace(baseURL), "/")
	if baseURL == "" {
		return nil
	}

	return &OrchestratorClient{
		baseURL:       baseURL,
		internalToken: strings.TrimSpace(internalToken),
		client: &http.Client{
			Timeout: 60 * time.Second,
		},
	}
}

func (client *OrchestratorClient) Validate(
	ctx context.Context,
	request answeruc.OrchestratorValidationRequest,
) (*answeruc.OrchestratorValidationResult, error) {
	if client == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("validation orchestrator unavailable")
	}

	payload, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	httpRequest, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(
		ctx,
		http.MethodPost,
		client.baseURL+"/api/v1/validate",
		bytes.NewReader(payload),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	httpRequest.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if client.internalToken != "" {
		httpRequest.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.internalToken)
	}

	response, err := client.client.Do(httpRequest)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()

	responseBody, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, maxValidationOrchestratorResponseBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if int64(len(responseBody)) > maxValidationOrchestratorResponseBytes {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("validation orchestrator response exceeds %d bytes", maxValidationOrchestratorResponseBytes)
	}

	if response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("validation orchestrator error: status=%d body=%s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(responseBody)))
	}

	var result answeruc.OrchestratorValidationResult
	if err := json.Unmarshal(responseBody, &result); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &result, nil
}
